diffViewer.title: Diff Viewer
diffViewer.description: Compare two texts by line and choose changed blocks for a merged document. Export the full comparison and merged text separately by copy or TXT.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Enter the left and right source texts, then select Compare. Full comparison does not run automatically while typing.
Review added, removed and unchanged counts and both source line numbers. Show all lines or changed lines only.
Editing marks the result as belonging to previous inputs. Current input results appear only after a new comparison completes.
Copying and TXT downloads export the last completed full result regardless of the filter or displayed page.
Choose Keep original or Use modified for changed blocks and inspect the merge preview. Separate merge copy and TXT actions export the entire selected document.

whatIs.title: What is the Diff Viewer?
whatIs.description: Inspect added, removed and unchanged lines with source line numbers, then choose the original or revised version for each changed block. Export comparison and merge results separately without overwriting inputs or saved manuscripts. Standard patches and three-way merging are not provided.

tips.title: Tips
items: Paste previous and new versions of code or documents, then explicitly start comparison.
Spaces and indentation count as differences. Line-ending types are normalized, while a final newline remains distinct.
Use the changed-lines filter for long documents. Copying and downloads still include the full result.

items.q: Does editing immediately update the result?
items.a: Editing cancels an in-progress comparison and marks the last result as previous-input data. Select Compare again to create a result for the new inputs.

items.q: How large can the documents be?
items.a: Each document may contain up to 1MiB of UTF-8 text and 10,000 lines. Work in changed regions is also bounded after common prefixes and suffixes are removed, so long texts with substantial differences may need to be split into sections.

items.q: How are spaces and line endings compared?
items.a: Spaces and indentation are compared. CRLF, CR and LF are equivalent, while a final newline is a distinct trailing empty line. Ignore-whitespace and word-level comparison options are not provided.

items.q: Can I apply the download as a patch?
items.a: It is a readable TXT with added, removed and unchanged prefixes. It is not a standard unified patch for automatically changing code.

items.q: Can I choose changes to produce a new document?
items.a: For each changed block in a successful comparison, choose Keep original or Use modified. All blocks initially keep the original. Copy or download the merged document separately; neither input nor saved manuscripts are overwritten. Editing an input marks the result as previous-input data.

items.q: Does the preview contain the entire merged document?
items.a: The preview shows 200 lines per page, up to 50,000 UTF-16 units per page and 2,000 per line, with omission notices. Copy and TXT contain the full merged document, up to 2MiB of UTF-8 and 20,000 lines. Line endings are normalized to LF while trailing newlines and blank lines are preserved, so this is not a byte-for-byte backup.

items.q: Can I compare text sent from the character counter?
items.a: An explicitly opened new tab can receive up to 50,000 characters per document with a 10-minute validity period. Source text is not put in the URL and comparison does not start automatically. Check both texts and select Compare.

workspace.exampleNotice: This short example shows how comparison works. Enter your source texts and compare to replace this result.
workspace.limits: Up to 1MiB of UTF-8 text and 10,000 lines per document. Long documents with large changed regions may need to be compared in sections.
workspace.running: Comparing the two confirmed source texts. You can cancel or edit the inputs.
workspace.canceled: Comparison canceled. The last completed result, if any, remains visible.
workspace.stale: The source text changed. The result below uses the previous inputs from the last completed comparison. Compare again for current inputs.
workspace.staleExport: Copy and download also export the full result shown below for the previous inputs. Compare again before exporting current source text.
workspace.exportScope: Copy and download contain the full comparison of the confirmed source texts. This is readable text, not a standard patch file for automatic application.
workspace.fullResultScope: Filters and pages affect displayed lines only. Statistics, copying and downloads always use the full confirmed result.
workspace.copyFailed: Automatic copying failed. Select the result text below and copy it manually.
workspace.manualLabel: Full result for manual copying (read only)
workspace.downloadFailed: Could not create the file or start its download. Use result copying or manual text selection.
workspace.bothEmpty: Both confirmed source texts are empty. There are no added, removed or unchanged lines.
workspace.noChanges: The confirmed texts have no changed lines. Choose All lines to see unchanged lines.
workspace.noResult: Enter two source texts and select Compare to view a result.
workspace.tableScroll: Comparison table · scroll horizontally for long lines
workspace.linePolicy: Comparison is line based and preserves spaces and indentation. CRLF, CR and LF are treated as equivalent line breaks, but a final newline is a distinct trailing empty line. An empty document has zero lines. + means added, − means removed, and an unmarked line is unchanged.
workspace.privacy: Source texts are not sent to a server or saved automatically. Comparison runs in this browser. Copying and file downloads happen only when you select their buttons.

errors.invalidInput: Could not read the source texts. Check both inputs and compare again.
errors.tooLarge: A document exceeds the 1MiB UTF-8 limit. Compare smaller sections. Any previous result is not a result of this new comparison.
errors.tooManyLines: A document exceeds 10,000 lines. Compare smaller sections.
errors.tooComplex: The changed regions exceed the comparison work limit. Compare smaller sections. This error does not mean the texts are identical or unchanged.
errors.unsupported: Background comparison is unavailable in this browser. Try another browser that supports it.
errors.workerFailed: Could not start or finish background comparison. Your source texts remain available to retry.
errors.invalidResponse: The comparison response could not be verified and was not used as a result. Compare again.
errors.timeout: Comparison was stopped after waiting too long for a response. Retry or compare smaller sections.

handoff.title: Documents from Character Counter
handoff.loaded: The saved and current text were received as they were when you clicked. Review both inputs, then select Compare. Later edits in the original tab are not applied here automatically.
handoff.edited: You edited or swapped the received inputs. The next comparison will use the two inputs shown now.
handoff.cleanupFailed: Both documents were received, but removal of the temporary transfer data could not be confirmed, or the data changed. Your current inputs are preserved.
handoff.privacy: The text is not included in this address. A successfully consumed transfer is not applied again after refresh. Copying the address does not create a link that shares both documents.

errors.missing: No transferred documents were found, or they were already used. Enter text as usual or send them again from the original Character Counter tab.
errors.invalid: The transfer format could not be validated, so your inputs were not changed. Send the documents again from the original Character Counter tab.
errors.unsupported: This transfer format is not supported. Your inputs and transfer data are preserved. Send the documents again from the original Character Counter tab.
errors.expired: The transfer is more than 10 minutes old and was not applied. Send the documents again from the original Character Counter tab.
errors.future: The transfer time could not be validated, so nothing was applied. Check your device's date and time, then send again.
errors.textTooLong: A transferred document exceeds 50,000 characters, so your inputs were not changed. Text entered directly is subject to the existing comparison limits.
errors.unavailable: Transfer storage could not be read, so your inputs were not changed. Enter text directly, or check your browser settings and send again.
errors.changed: The transfer data changed while it was being checked, so your inputs were not changed. The newer data was not deleted.
errors.edited: You already edited an input or started a comparison, so the transferred documents were not applied. Your current inputs are preserved.
errors.applyFailed: The transferred documents could not be applied. The transfer data was not deleted. Send again from the original tab or enter text directly.

merge.title: Merge selected changes
merge.description: Choose the original or modified text for each block. All blocks start with the original text. Your two input documents stay unchanged.
merge.previous: This merge uses the two documents from the previous comparison. Compare again to include your current edits.
merge.invalid: The merge does not match the comparison. Compare the documents again.
merge.noChanges: No changed blocks. You can use the original content as it is.
merge.empty: The merged document is empty. Copying clears the clipboard; the TXT download will be an empty file.
merge.shortened: Long lines and some content are shortened in the preview. Copy and TXT include the complete document.
merge.previewHint: Each page shows up to 200 lines. Copy and TXT include content from every page.
merge.lineEndings: Line endings are normalized to LF. Trailing newlines and blank lines are kept.
merge.failed: Could not create the merge. Your last confirmed result is kept. Compare the documents again.

output.downloadFailed: Could not start downloading {label}. Try again.
output.failed: Could not copy the {label} automatically. Open the full text to select it manually, or try again.
output.selectionFailed: Could not select the text automatically. Select it directly in the field.
output.empty: This is an empty document. You can also download it as a TXT file.
